tools.name: list_bots
tools.description: List all DCA bots with their ID, status, type, trading pair, and exchange

status.description: Filter by status: scheduled, executing, waiting, retrying, stopped, created (optional)

tools.name: get_bot_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific bot including performance metrics (P/L, average price, invested, current value)

tools.name: list_exchanges
tools.description: List connected exchanges with API key status

tools.name: get_exchange_balances
tools.description: Fetch live balances from a connected exchange. Requires the exchange name (e.g., 'Binance', 'Kraken', 'Coinbase').

tools.name: get_portfolio_summary
tools.description: Get a portfolio summary including global P/L, bot count breakdown, and per-bot P/L with each bot ID

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: List recent transactions (trades) with optional bot filter and limit

limit.description: Number of transactions to return (default: 20, max: 100)

tools.name: start_bot
tools.description: Start a stopped or newly created DCA bot. A bot that can sell is refused until the wash-sale question is answered in the web app.

start_fresh.description: Omitted or true: resets the schedule and can place an order immediately, unless a future starting time applies. false: keeps the schedule, but can invest amounts missed while the bot was stopped.

tools.name: update_bot_settings
tools.description: Change a stopped bot's settings, as its settings page does: amount, interval, label, exchange; index count and flattening; basket weights, members and weighting; selling amounts; Smart Intervals; limit orders; starting time; spending and selling caps; price, price-drop, moving-average and RSI conditions; rebalancing. Only what you pass changes; each field says which bot types have it.

quote_amount.description: Amount per order, in the quote currency.

num_coins.description: Index bots: how many top assets to hold (2-100); the top of the range holds them all.

allocation_flattening.description: Index bots: 0 = market-cap weights, 1 = equal weights.

allocations.description: Basket bots: weights in percent for any members, e.g. 'BTC:70,ETH:30'. Members not named keep their weight (rounded to 0.1, as the page does); weights need not sum to 100 to save, but must to start. Name a member by its key from get_bot_details when two share a symbol, or by asset id.

exchange_id.description: Move the bot to another connected exchange (id from list_exchanges).

weighting.description: Basket bots: manual weights, or weights derived from market cap.

add_asset_id.description: Basket bots: add this asset (id) as a member with weight 0.

remove_asset_id.description: Basket bots: remove this member (asset id).

normalize_allocations.description: Basket bots: true scales the weights to sum to 100.

sell_amount.description: While selling a one-asset basket: base amount to sell per sell interval. null clears it.

sell_quote_amount.description: While selling: quote amount to sell for per sell interval. null clears it.

smart_intervaled.description: Smart Intervals (split each order into smaller, more frequent ones): on or off.

smart_interval_quote_amount.description: Smart Intervals: size of each smaller buy, in the quote currency.

smart_interval_base_amount.description: Smart Intervals while selling a base amount: size of each smaller sell.

limit_ordered.description: Limit orders instead of market orders: on or off (always on for Hyperliquid).

limit_order_pcnt_distance.description: Limit orders: distance from the price, in percent (0.5 = 0.5%).

start_time_enabled.description: Starting time (delay the first order): on or off.

start_time_mode.description: Starting time: a weekday, a date (start_at), or the next occurrence of an hour (start_time_of_day).

start_time_of_day.description: Starting time for weekday or hour modes: 'HH:MM' in the account time zone.

start_at.description: Starting time for date mode: a datetime, e.g. 2026-06-15T09:30 in the account time zone or with an offset. null clears it.

quote_amount_limited.description: Spending cap (don't spend more than) while buying: on or off.

quote_amount_limit.description: Spending cap, in the quote currency.

base_amount_limited.description: Selling cap (don't sell more than) for a one-asset basket: on or off.

base_amount_limit.description: Selling cap, in the base asset.

price_limited.description: Price condition while buying: on or off.

price_limit_mode.description: Price condition while buying: what it does.

price_limit_value_condition.description: Price condition while buying: price above, below or between (between needs mode restrict).

price_limit.description: Price condition while buying: the price, in the quote currency.

price_limit_range_lower_bound.description: Price condition while buying: lower price of a between range.

price_limit_range_upper_bound.description: Price condition while buying: upper price of a between range.

price_limit_in_ticker_id.description: Price condition while buying. Basket bots: the ticker id of the member it watches (get_bot_details lists them).

price_drop_limited.description: Price-drop condition while buying: on or off.

price_drop_limit_mode.description: Price-drop condition while buying: what it does.

price_drop_limit.description: Price-drop condition while buying: the move, in percent (10 = 10%) below the high.

price_drop_limit_time_window_condition.description: Price-drop condition while buying: the high it is measured from.

price_drop_limit_in_ticker_id.description: Price-drop condition while buying. Basket bots: the ticker id of the member it watches (get_bot_details lists them).

moving_average_limited.description: Moving-average condition while buying: on or off.

moving_average_limit_mode.description: Moving-average condition while buying: what it does.

moving_average_limit_value_condition.description: Moving-average condition while buying: price above or below the average.

moving_average_limit_in_ma_type.description: Moving-average condition while buying: the average.

moving_average_limit_in_timeframe.description: Moving-average condition while buying: candle size.

moving_average_limit_in_period.description: Moving-average condition while buying: number of candles.

moving_average_limit_in_ticker_id.description: Moving-average condition while buying. Basket bots: the ticker id of the member it watches (get_bot_details lists them).

indicator_limited.description: RSI condition while buying: on or off.

indicator_limit_mode.description: RSI condition while buying: what it does.

indicator_limit_value_condition.description: RSI condition while buying: indicator above or below the level.

indicator_limit.description: RSI condition while buying: the level (0-100).

indicator_limit_in_indicator.description: RSI condition while buying: the indicator.

indicator_limit_in_timeframe.description: RSI condition while buying: candle size.

indicator_limit_in_ticker_id.description: RSI condition while buying. Basket bots: the ticker id of the member it watches (get_bot_details lists them).

sell_price_limited.description: Price condition while selling: on or off.

sell_price_limit_mode.description: Price condition while selling: what it does.

sell_price_limit_value_condition.description: Price condition while selling: price above, below or between (between needs mode restrict).

sell_price_limit.description: Price condition while selling: the price, in the quote currency.

sell_price_limit_range_lower_bound.description: Price condition while selling: lower price of a between range.

sell_price_limit_range_upper_bound.description: Price condition while selling: upper price of a between range.

sell_price_limit_in_ticker_id.description: Price condition while selling. Basket bots: the ticker id of the member it watches (get_bot_details lists them).

sell_price_drop_limited.description: Price-drop condition while selling: on or off.

sell_price_drop_limit_mode.description: Price-drop condition while selling: what it does.

sell_price_drop_limit.description: Price-drop condition while selling: the move, in percent (10 = 10%) above the low.

sell_price_drop_limit_time_window_condit.description: Price-drop condition while selling: the low it is measured from.

sell_price_drop_limit_in_ticker_id.description: Price-drop condition while selling. Basket bots: the ticker id of the member it watches (get_bot_details lists them).

sell_moving_average_limited.description: Moving-average condition while selling: on or off.

sell_moving_average_limit_mode.description: Moving-average condition while selling: what it does.

sell_moving_average_limit_value_conditio.description: Moving-average condition while selling: price above or below the average.

sell_moving_average_limit_in_ma_type.description: Moving-average condition while selling: the average.

sell_moving_average_limit_in_timeframe.description: Moving-average condition while selling: candle size.

sell_moving_average_limit_in_period.description: Moving-average condition while selling: number of candles.

sell_moving_average_limit_in_ticker_id.description: Moving-average condition while selling. Basket bots: the ticker id of the member it watches (get_bot_details lists them).

sell_indicator_limited.description: RSI condition while selling: on or off.

sell_indicator_limit_mode.description: RSI condition while selling: what it does.

sell_indicator_limit_value_condition.description: RSI condition while selling: indicator above or below the level.

sell_indicator_limit.description: RSI condition while selling: the level (0-100).

sell_indicator_limit_in_indicator.description: RSI condition while selling: the indicator.

sell_indicator_limit_in_timeframe.description: RSI condition while selling: candle size.

sell_indicator_limit_in_ticker_id.description: RSI condition while selling. Basket bots: the ticker id of the member it watches (get_bot_details lists them).

rebalance_threshold.description: Threshold rebalancing: drift that triggers it, in percent (5 = 5%). null clears it (the default applies).

tools.name: list_open_orders
tools.description: List currently open (unfilled) orders across all connected exchanges

tools.name: list_tax_jurisdictions
tools.description: List all supported tax jurisdictions with their calculation method and currency

tools.name: delete_bot
tools.description: Delete a bot (running or not). Its schedule is cancelled; its history is kept but hidden.

tools.name: archive_bot
tools.description: Archive a bot: it stops, leaves the dashboard, keeps its history. Reactivate with unarchive_bot.

tools.name: unarchive_bot
tools.description: Bring an archived bot back, stopped.
